en: Obadiah 1

p.src: 1  The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

ja: は、エドムについてこう
われる。 われわれは
がれ。 エドムに立ち
en: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.
u.src: 1  The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom. We have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

ja:
1:1 「主」と訳された語は「アドナイ」である。
1:1 すべて大文字で記される「主」または「神」は、神の固有の御名（ヘブル語「יהוה」、通常「ヤハウェ」と発音される）の訳である。
en:
1:1 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”
1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

ja: とした。 あなたは大いに蔑まれている。
en: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
u.src: 2  Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

ja: 1:2 「見よ」はヘブル語「הִנֵּה」に由来し、「見なさい」「注目せよ」「よく見よ」などの意味を持つ間投詞である。
en: 1:2 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 3  The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

en: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
u.src: 3  The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

p.src: 4  Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.

ja: を設けても、 私はそこからあなたを
en: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
u.src: 4  Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.

p.src: 5  “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

ja: たなら、 ああ、なんという災いがあなたを待つことか。
むのではないか。 もしぶどうを
たなら、 いくらかの実を
en: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?
u.src: 5  “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

p.src: 6  How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

ja: エサウは、なんと荒らし尽くされることか。 その
は、なんと捜し出されることか。
en: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!
u.src: 6  How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

p.src: 7  All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

ja: り返した。 あなたと平
った。 あなたのパンを
べていた友は、 あなたの足もとにわなを
en: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
u.src: 7  All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

p.src: 8  “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

ja: たちを滅ぼし、 エサウの
en: “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?
u.src: 8  “Won’t I in that day”, says the LORD, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

p.src: 9  Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

ja: たちはうろたえる。 こうして、エサウの
は皆、 ことごとく剣に倒れ、
en: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.
u.src: 9  Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

p.src: 10  For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

en: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
u.src: 10  For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

p.src: 11  In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

ja: あなたが傍らに立って見ていた日、 よそ
り、 エルサレムをめぐってくじを引いた
en: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.
u.src: 11  In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

p.src: 12  But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

ja: してはならない。 ユダの民が
en: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
u.src: 12  But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

p.src: 13  Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

en: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.
u.src: 13  Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

p.src: 14  Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

ja: 逃れる者を断ち滅ぼそうと、
en: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.
u.src: 14  Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

p.src: 15  For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

ja: 々に迫っている。 あなたがしたように、あなたにもなされる。 あなたの仕業は、あなた
en: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
u.src: 15  For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

p.src: 16  For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

ja: んだように、 すべての
し、 初めからいなかったかのようになる。
en: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
u.src: 16  For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

u.src: 17  But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

p.src: 18  The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.

もいなくなる。」 まことに、

する。 セファラデにいるエルサレムの
